en.headline: Most Po Pin Chau visitors say booking eased crowds
en.dek: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said about 1,160 people visited the section on Tuesday under the trial booking system.
body: Most visitors surveyed on the Po Pin Chau section of the High Island Geo Trail said the trial booking system had made the visit smoother, the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said on Tuesday.

The department said about 1,160 people visited the section that day. Staff on site and drone monitoring found the trail and viewing platform largely moving freely. In a questionnaire on the visitor experience, most respondents said crowd levels were clearly better controlled after booking began, and that the viewpoint was easier to use than before.
The department said that over recent days most visitors had followed staff instructions and taken their rubbish away.

It has also stepped up management, cleaning and rubbish collection at Ham Tin Wan, Long Ke Wan and Sai Wan campsites in Sai Kung, with extra staff on day and night patrols. About 190 tents were counted at the three camps on Monday night, and the department said hygiene and order were good.

zh.headline: 破邊洲大部分遊人稱預約後體驗更好
zh.dek: 漁護署表示周二約1160人到訪東壩破邊洲段，問卷中大部分遊人稱預約制有效控制人流，觀景台較以前暢順。
body: 漁農自然護理署表示，西貢東壩破邊洲路段試行預約制期間，問卷調查中大部分遊人稱實施預約後體驗更好。
署方指，周二約有1160人到訪破邊洲段。現場人員及無人機監測顯示，山徑及觀景台人流大致暢順。署方在社交平台說，大部分受訪遊人表示預約制明顯有效控制人流，遊覽觀景台比以前暢順。
署方又說，過去多日大部分遊人都聽從工作人員指示，自行帶走垃圾。
漁護署同時加強西貢鹹田灣、浪茄灣及西灣營地的管理、清潔和垃圾收集，並加派人員日夜巡邏及駐守。周一晚三個營地共有約190個帳篷，衞生及秩序良好。
